item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:50 HKT 07/Aug/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine and very hot over southern China in the next couple of days. Besides, the area of low pressure now near Luzon will enter the South China Sea in the next couple of days and its intensity will remain relatively weak. It will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea early next week. With the anticyclone aloft shifting northwards, showers will increase gradually over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Another area of low pressure over the western North Pacific is expected to move westwards in the next few days and develop gradually. There are still uncertainties over its subsequent movement and intensity.
